capabilities: Close the current note tab via a command
Switch to the next, previous, last, or numbered note tab
Control which tab is focused after closing the current tab
extras: Setup requires manually rebinding hotkeys in settings to use the plugin's commands instead of the built-in ones; the focus-after-close setting only works when closing via the plugin's command, not via the tab's X button or middle click.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's built-in tab management commands will apply to the tab group you most recently interacted with.
motivation: The author personally disliked that built-in tab shortcuts unreliably hit sidebar widget tabs, so they made commands that reliably apply to note tabs.
problem: Obsidian's built-in tab commands apply to the most recently interacted tab group, so hotkeys like ctrl+W can accidentally close or switch a sidebar widget instead of a note.

relations.evidence: This is complementary to the Pin Enhancer plugin, since you can't use that plugin's

summary: Tab-management commands (close, next, previous, jump to tab N) that always target note tabs in the main area, never sidebar widget tabs.
